versions.changelog:
- Renamed skill from "talent-powers" to "builder-data"
- Removed reference files: endpoints.md, github-enrichment.md, and use-cases.md
- Updated and clarified credential requirements (explicit API key and optional GitHub token)
- Revised endpoint descriptions and made GitHub enrichment details clearer
- Improved instructions for using filters, especially the recommendation to use ranks by default and only fetch scores if asked
- Simplified and clarified sample requests and parameter explanations

- query builder reputation and professional data from Talent Protocol.

- Map Twitter accounts to wallets, and access builder credentials (earnings, contributions, hackathons, contracts, etc).
- Discover what each builder is working on
- geo-location of builders
